svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make four. Cut 45 x 70 mm softwood to 470 mm, ends square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drawn: the rail nearest the right-hand legs. Saw a notch 15 mm wide

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (along the bench) by 25 mm long out of each end, full height, on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the side toward the legs, so the rail clears their corners.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The other three rails are plain.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ends: two 4 mm pilot holes 40 mm deep, 13 and 56 mm up from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: lower edge (in the unnotched 30 mm of the notched rail).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: tops flush with the aprons; centres 210, 510, 757.5 and 1,012.5 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the inside face of the left legs. Two 6 x 100 mm structural

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: screws through the apron into each end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The two 8.5 mm holes shown (tile rails only) are drilled in step 10.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: each rail drops between the aprons without forcing.
